Content: “The system of quotas ... was the `text(first)` major pillar of the Immigration Act of `text(1924)`. The `text(second)` provided for the exclusion of persons ineligible to citizenship... Ineligibility to citizenship and exclusion applied to the peoples of all the nations of East and South Asia. Nearly all Asians had already been excluded from immigration... The exclusion of persons ineligible to citizenship in `text(1924)` ... completed Asiatic exclusion... Moreover, it codified the principle of racial exclusion into the main body of American immigration and naturalization law.”
